transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... for over a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to actually take this seriously. It's about my job. The new ticket rotation and the security audits they're doing—they're being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps pulling me in, showing me logs, and saying it’s just standard policy. But... I know what I'm looking at. I just need someone to understand what's really happening.
During this time, have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one else was around?

No, no. I haven't heard any voices or anything like that. My hearing is fine. I haven't experienced any strange sounds when I'm alone, either. Like I said, what I'm dealing with is all right there in the system—it's actual data and logs on the network, not... not me hearing things in my head.
Aside from the stress at work, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, I haven't been feeling depressed or hopeless. I mean, obviously, the situation at work is incredibly frustrating... and it definitely takes a toll on you to deal with that kind of pressure every day. But I'm not walking around feeling down in the dumps or anything like that. 

I'm just trying to deal with the problem in front of me. If anything, I'm just highly focused on getting this sorted out and protecting myself. So no, I wouldn't say I'm depressed.
Have you noticed similar issues with people being untrustworthy or working against you in your personal life, like with friends or family?

No, not at all. It's... it's really just at the office. Outside of this whole issue with the ticket rotation and the audits, everything is fine. I don't have any problems with my friends or family. 

I still keep the house in order, make sure the bills are paid... I help my wife out with whatever she needs around the house. And honestly, even at work, I handle the technical parts of my job without any issues. Nobody is saying my actual work is sloppy or disorganized, because I know what I'm doing. It's just that specific situation with management. So, no, my personal life is completely normal.
